title: Monthly usage event count per account, 2025
prompt: Product wants monthly active-usage counts per account for 2025 — total usage events per account per month. What does a row represent at the start, and what do you need it to represent at the end?
grain: Starts at one row per usage event; ends at one row per account per month.
metricDefinition: count of usage_events per account per month, for 2025.
referenceSql: SELECT account_id, date_trunc('month', occurred_at) AS month, count(*) AS event_count FROM usage_events WHERE occurred_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND occurred_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY account_id, date_trunc('month', occurred_at)
